shared_elements: animal shown in profile with distinct head and eye
repeated creatures stacked in roughly horizontal rows or registers
small circle/disc motif (eye-dot in B, discs in A)
engraved/carved line work on a pale stone-like surface
zigzag or chevron-like linear filler pattern
justification: Both surfaces stack profile creatures with long, snaking bodies in loosely horizontal tiers, and both use a small dotted circle to mark the eye, which is the most specific point of contact. But A is deep, rounded relief on a large architectural block with varied subjects (quadrupeds, human-like figures, a band of hatching), whereas B is a fine, uniform incised linear drawing on a small curved object built almost entirely from repeated spiky zigzag bodies, so the manner of execution and overall impression differ sharply.
